name: Muigin and Larion
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
See Larion over there? It's HIS fault we're here!

I told him we were going the wrong way, but would he listen? And would you believe that he's the one that won't speak to me? Well, until he changes his mind, let's have a bit of fun with him.

Have you noticed the strange plant-like creatures around here? They're nothing but trouble, really, but I think if trained properly, I could get them to obey commands.

First thing though, I'll need some samples to study. Do you think you could collect some?
narrative.objectives: Collect 15 Bloodpetals and return to Muigin.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I hope they didn't give you too much trouble, adventurer. I try to steer clear of them -- they're wild!

I tried jumping over one... I was attacked! Plants just shouldn't be acting that way!
narrative.requestItemsText: Larion's got something coming, that's for sure!
